note: Platform cut-off dates that endoflife.date does not model, because they belong to a platform rather than to a release line. Deliberately short: everything that can come from a live feed does. Each rule carries the primary source it was read from.

rules.headline: GitHub Actions runners remove Node 20
rules.detail: An action whose action.yml declares runs.using: node20 will not start once Node 20 is removed from the runner images. Node 24 has been the default since 2026-06-16, and the ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION escape hatch stops working on the same day.
rules.fix: Upgrade to a release of the action that declares runs.using: node24.

rules.headline: Vercel disables Node 20 for builds and functions
rules.detail: New deployments of a project set to Node 20 fail from this date. Deployments already live keep serving.
rules.fix: Raise the Node version in engines.node or .nvmrc and in the Vercel project settings.

rules.headline: AWS Lambda blocks new python3.9 functions
rules.detail: New functions can no longer be created on python3.9; existing functions can no longer be updated after 2026-09-30. Functions already deployed keep running.
rules.fix: Move the function to a supported Python runtime such as python3.13.

rules.headline: Dependabot stopped supporting Python 3.9
rules.detail: Dependabot no longer opens dependency update pull requests for projects pinned to Python 3.9.
rules.fix: Raise the pinned Python version so dependency updates keep arriving.
